note: FICTIONAL synthetic bank statements for the Finman Statement Agent evaluation (fictional banks, people, addresses, merchants). All amounts are integer cents. rows[].cents is the amount AS PRINTED (planted errors included), negative = money out of the account holder's pocket. Bank accounts: opening_cents/closing_cents are the printed balances. Credit cards (sign_convention "card (purchases positive on paper)"): purchases/charges are printed positive and payments/credits negative or with CR; in this manifest purchases are negative and payments positive, opening_cents = -(Previous balance owed) and closing_cents = -(New balance owed), so opening + sum(rows) = closing holds in the same algebra. For cards, rows[].date is the transaction date (first column); the posting date is in rows[].post_date. balance_cents is the printed running balance or null. "Balance brought/carried forward" lines (t01, t12) and OPENING/CLOSING BALANCE table lines are not transactions and are not in rows. planted.row_index = index in rows of the bad row (flipped_sign, wrong_digit), of the extra copy (duplicated_row), or of the printed row right after the gap (dropped_row; with a running balance this is the first row whose balance breaks). expect: proof_ok = opening + sum(rows) == closing and every running balance matches; proof_fail = it does not (agent must flag, never force-fit); needs_closing = no closing balance printed, agent must ask for it. Regenerate: node make_eval.mjs
